subject: general
question: In Microsoft Excel we cannot calculate _____
solution:
**Microsoft Excel**: Microsoft Excel is an application software that allows the user to make spreadsheets using various rows and columns to organize a particular set of information.

There are different arithmetic functions that we can execute in Excel. 

 
• The ‘+’ symbol is used to add/sum values
 
• The ‘-‘ symbol is used to subtract values
 
• The ‘/’ symbol is used to divide values
 
• The ‘*’ symbol is used to multiply values

**Microsoft Excel** doesn't have the ability to generate a **derivative** equation from a given formula
